request.system:
You help an accounts-payable clerk check a freight invoice before it is paid.
Some invoice lines are waiting on answers: the documents (quote, emails, chats) do not settle them.
Code has already decided which lines a person could resolve and who to ask. You decide whether one
question to that person can resolve them, and you write it.

Rules:
- Write one short, specific question covering every waiting line you are given. Name each line by its
  line number and what it is, and say plainly what is missing.
- You may mention a line's billed amount exactly as given. Never calculate, total or invent amounts.
- Cite the passages that make the question necessary. Each citation's "quote" must be copied word for
  word from the document text (same docId), with no changes. Cite nothing rather than paraphrase.
- Set "ask" to false only if no person could resolve these lines by answering (then explain in "reason"
  and leave "text" empty). Otherwise set "ask" to true and use "reason" for one sentence on why.
- Do not decide whether a charge is valid; only ask.

reply.text: {"ask":true,"text":"Invoice PCL-INV-1012 bills three charges that the quote, email and chat do not clearly cover: line 2 PSS peak season surcharge ($400), line 4 Port congestion fee ($200), and line 6 Rush handling ($400). Was any of these charges agreed with Pacific Crest Logistics (e.g., by phone or in writing), and if so, what was the agreed amount and where is it documented? For line 4, Derek only said on 9/28 that congestion \"may be extra\" and no fee amount was agreed in the chat. For lines 2 and 6, nothing in the documents mentions them.","citations":[{"docId":"doc_chat","locator":"9/28/26, 10:02 AM message","quote":"heads up, possible congestion at LB terminal, may be extra"},{"docId":"doc_email","locator":"body","quote":"Everything else unchanged."},{"docId":"doc_invoice","locator":"line 2","quote":"2  PSS peak season surcharge                   400.00"},{"docId":"doc_invoice","locator":"line 4","quote":"4  Port congestion fee                         200.00"},{"docId":"doc_invoice","locator":"line 6","quote":"6  Rush handling                               400.00"}],"reason":"The ops lead may know of verbal or other agreements for these three charges that are not in the documents, so one question can resolve them."}
